label: Total income per tax filer (Canada)
definition: Total income reported by one individual Canadian tax filer for one tax year, in Canadian dollars. It includes earnings, investment income, pensions, spousal support, other taxable income, government transfers and refundable tax credits, ranked against all tax filers nationally by Statistics Canada.
